name: Executive Overview

notes.title: One platform. Two stages.
notes.text: Online video submission leads into an offline live pitching round for selected teams.

bio: VentureX is a national-level investor-connect program by the Entrepreneurship Cell at BMS Institute of Technology & Management. It brings promising startups and potential investors together, giving founders a place to pitch their ventures and present their business potential.

The journey has two stages. Teams first submit a startup pitch and video demonstration online for investor evaluation. Shortlisted teams then present their products, business models, and vision in an offline idea-pitching round.
The event lasts 7 hours, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Teams have 3 to 4 members. The venue is BMS Institute of Technology & Management in Yelahanka, Bengaluru.

name: FAQs

notes.title: Open innovation
notes.text: Startups from any domain or industry are welcome to participate.

bio: VentureX welcomes student teams with startup ideas from any industry. Use these quick answers to check eligibility, team composition, and the participation fee information provided in the event document.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to participate?
faqs.answer: Students enrolled in accredited higher education institutions across India are eligible.

faqs.question: Is there an entry fee?
faqs.answer: Round 1 online video submission is free. Teams shortlisted for the Round 2 offline finale pay an administrative confirmation fee per team. It covers venue access, food, connectivity, and kits; the document does not state the amount.

faqs.question: What are the team size parameters?
faqs.answer: Teams must comprise 3 to 4 members. Cross-college and inter-departmental team compositions are permitted.

faqs.question: Is there a specific domain or track for startups?
faqs.answer: No. VentureX follows an open innovation approach, so startups from any domain or industry are welcome.
